title: GPT-6.2 introduces identity verification requirements for sensitive tasks
summary: GPT-6.2 requires mandatory KYC identity verification and government credentials for high-risk autonomous workflows and dual-use cybersecurity operations.
research_notes:
Access the developer dashboard and select the GPT-6.2 model family endpoint.

Submit government-issued photo identification and complete the automated 3D liveness check when prompted for restricted capability tiers.

Register an approved FIDO2 hardware security key for administrative and cybersecurity task execution.

Complete organizational verification in advance to prevent automated account freezes during high-consequence API workflows.

Configure dedicated service accounts with hardware-backed credentials instead of personal developer accounts for enterprise deployments.
